page_title: Dao Browser - AI Browser with Vertical Tabs, Built on Chromium

summary.name: Dao Browser
summary.one_liner: Dao Browser is an open-source, Chromium-based browser for macOS featuring vertical tabs, a Spotlight-style command bar, and a built-in AI agent.
use_cases: browse the web with vertical tabs on a Mac
ask an AI assistant about the page you are reading
work side by side with split view
keep legacy Manifest V2 extensions running
navigate the browser using keyboard shortcuts
summary.what_it_does: Dao Browser is a Chromium-based browser that presents tabs as a resizable vertical list, with folders, favorites, and collapsing. A Spotlight-style command bar handles URL detection, search routing, and AI questions via Cmd+L. A native AI sidebar (Cmd+E) offers long-term memory, suggestion cards that only call AI after the user clicks Run, and visible actions, and it supports bring-your-own models such as Gemini, GPT, or Claude. Other features include per-host skills, macOS immersive full-screen mode, Force Dark Mode, Picture-in-Picture, split view, and MV2 extension compatibility. The page states it is a real Chromium build, currently at v1.0.127 with Chromium 155.0.8059.86.
notable: Vertical tabs resizable from 150 to 400 pixels, collapsible with one keystroke
AI agent only calls AI after the user chooses Run, with bring-your-own-model support
Host-aware skills that load site-specific workflows on navigation
Real Chromium build with MV2 extension compatibility
caveats: Macos Apple Silicon build is available now; Linux and Windows are listed as coming soon
The page describes the browser as open source but gives no license details
